requests.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL hand-painted fantasy RPG VFX production sprite source sheet, transparent RGBA background, no environment, no characters, no text, no letters, no numbers, no real-world symbols, no ground rings, no low-leg auras. Twelve isolated painted effects arranged in EXACTLY 4 equal columns and 3 equal rows with generous transparent padding inside EVERY cell, no dividers. Landscape 3:2 canvas. Row 1 is TAUNT stone grey and warm amber: column 1 a small heavy fractured stone-like abstract chest rune of three uneven blunt shards (invented shape, not alphabet); column 2 a broad upright rolling crescent pulse traveling from left to right, chunky grey strokes rimmed amber, clear open interior; column 3 sparse amber-edged stone motes for the rolling pulse; column 4 a very small brief glowing abstract three-shard chest mark. Row 2 is CHALLENGE gold and ivory: column 1 small narrow gold shield-shaped gleam; column 2 sharp faceted luminous shield crest flash with open transparent centre, no heraldry, no cross, no star, thin sharp gold-white edges; column 3 a SINGLE very thin horizontal gold-white directional light thread going left to right with fine taper, visually quiet; column 4 tiny pointed shield outline crest to sit just above a physical shield at chest level. Row 3 is WARCRY ivory and desaturated teal: column 1 compressed wispy breath-like curved brush flick, no mouth; column 2 directional expanding shout shockwave CONE pointing from left origin to right wide edge, three separated ivory-teal curved pressure ribs with transparent gaps, airy torn brush ends, never a full circle; column 3 ONE compact ivory-teal irregular impact flash, small, no symbolic star geometry, reusable once per affected foe; column 4 two fading short wisps and teal dust. Cohesive premium painterly 2D game effects, textured gouache brush edges, softly emissive colored edges, navy-compatible palette amber #d7b06d ivory #fff0cb teal #7ccfc8 stone #78858c, highly readable at 48-96px displayed sizes. R1 visual direction: weighty chipped taunt, precise upright challenge, airy broad warcry, restrained soft bloom, strong silhouette distinction. All effects fully isolated from every neighbouring cell. No baked checkerboard or background.

Re-layout this original transparent production sheet without changing the painting style or color palette. Preserve the 12 exact effect concepts, 4 columns by 3 rows, but make EACH effect 25% smaller inside its own equal cell so there is generous FULLY TRANSPARENT padding on all four sides. Row 1 amber stone chest rune / rolling stone pulse / sparse motes / small mark. Row 2 gold narrow gleam / sharp open shield crest / thin directional line / small open shield crest. Row 3 teal-ivory compressed breath / 3-rib cone / compact single impact / wisps. All pixels of each effect including glow must stay within its OWN 384x341 cell. Especially keep the big shield bottom tip away from the teal cone below, and keep the cone inside column 2. The thin line must point right, left-to-right motion. Truly transparent background and hollow interiors, no text, no real symbols, no characters, no floor rings, no panels or dividers. Landscape 1536x1024 source sheet.
